quests.title: Sightseeing With Friends: Scenic Highlights

dialogue.t: Hehe, next up is a special route Paimon picked out after really careful planning! We'll be walking for a while, though...
First stop, the desert oasis! Then we'll head through Mawtiyima Forest, and after that, back to Bayda Harbor!
Paimon's been thinking about this... The desert, forest, and valleys in Sumeru all feel super different! But we've pretty much never seen them all in one trip, have we?
Good thing we don't have to rush this time. Paimon says we should take it nice and slow and soak it all in!

dialogue.sit: Sure thing! No rush, just vibes!
Yup! Outings are meant to be nice and chill.

dialogue.t: Ooh, our Fungi friends look ready and raring to go! Let's hit the road!

quests.description: Paimon seems to have her own thoughts about sightseeing and photo spots in Sumeru…
